text: * If you are placed in charge of a dinner party, don't try to act important. Just make sure all the guests have what they need
before you are seated. Then enjoy the dinner with everyone else, and they will honor you for a job well done.
If you are an older guest, it is right for you to talk. But be sure what you say is true, and don't talk during the music
or other entertainment. That is not the right time for clever remarks. *
Good wine and good music at a banquet
are like rubies and emeralds in settings of gold.
If you are a younger guest, don't talk unless someone asks you a question. Don't speak more than twice,
and say as much as you can in as few words as possible. This will show your knowledge and also your self-control.
Treat important people with proper respect, and don't chatter on and on if someone older is talking.
Lightning goes ahead of thunder, and if you are humble, you will be liked and accepted before you even arrive.
Then later, at the proper time, just say goodbye and go home. Don't wait around to be the last to leave.
At home, you can have fun doing whatever you want— but be careful not to sin by speaking with arrogance.
And give thanks to your Creator, who lets you enjoy all the good things he made.
If you obey the Lord, expect him to correct you, but do your best, and you will be accepted.
Sincerely studying God's Law will bring contentment, but if you are not sincere that Law will condemn you.
If you obey the Lord, you will be well known for justice and fairness.
But sinners refuse to be corrected, and they twist the Law so they can do whatever they please.
A wise person can take a hint, but even fear of great danger won't stop an arrogant fool.[69]
Give plenty of thought to what you will do, and afterwards, don't worry about how well you did.
Don't look for trouble, but learn from your mistakes.[70]
It's easy to be careless on a smooth road,
so always pay attention to the path ahead.[71]
Think your actions through,[72] and you will be able to obey the Lord's commands.
If you believe in God's Law, then do what it says. Trust the Lord, and you will have success.
